notes.title: Game Update - 2/10/2017
notes.notes:
ChangeLog:

- Resolution can be changed in Options
- Full Screen / Windows mode available in Options. ( alt + enter shortcut is enabled)
- 30 FPS Cap removed.
- Fixed achievement „Skin changer”
- Player Stats can be reset only in Town.
- Fixed items prices in blacksmith shop.
- Chests gives more gold now.
